$comment: Pinned external dependencies for Rebuild Studio on Windows. Consumed by scripts/windows/Setup-Dependencies.ps1 and Doctor-RebuildStudio.ps1. An artifact with sha256 == null is NEVER installed (verify_required). Compute with: Setup-Dependencies.ps1 -ComputeHash <tool>, review the source, then paste the value here.

rizin.role: Native analysis engine (subprocess via rzpipe; LGPL-3.0, never linked)

artifact.name: rizin-windows-static-v0.9.1.zip
artifact.hash_provenance: computed by downloading the release asset on 2026-10-06 (Linux build host)

gdre.role: Godot PCK recovery (gdsdecomp / GDRE tools, MIT)

artifact.name: GDRE_tools-v2.7.0-windows.zip
artifact.hash_provenance: computed by downloading the release asset on 2026-10-06 (Linux build host)

ilspycmd.role: .NET decompiler CLI (ILSpy, MIT). Framework-dependent; needs the .NET 8 runtime below.

artifact.name: ilspycmd.9.1.0.7988.nupkg
artifact.hash_provenance: computed by downloading the nupkg on 2026-10-06 (Linux build host)

dotnet-runtime.role: .NET 8 shared runtime (Microsoft.NETCore.App) for ilspycmd. Installed side by side under tools\dotnet; no machine-wide install.

artifact.name: dotnet-runtime-8.0.31-win-x64.zip
artifact.hash_provenance: 2026-10-06 on Windows 11 (interactive host): downloaded from builds.dotnet.microsoft.com; SHA-512 matched the official value in https://builds.dotnet.microsoft.com/dotnet/release-metadata/8.0/releases.json (release 8.0.31, file dotnet-runtime-win-x64.zip); sha256 computed locally from the same verified bytes.

node.role: Optional: JS/Electron extraction (@electron/asar) at runtime. Not required for native/.NET/Godot paths.

artifact.name: node-v22.22.0-win-x64.zip
artifact.hash_provenance: computed by downloading the zip on 2026-10-06 and matched against nodejs.org SHASUMS256.txt

webview2_evergreen_bootstrapper.role: Required by Tauri on Windows. Evergreen runtime is NOT bundled; Install-RebuildStudio.ps1 checks for it and downloads the small bootstrapper if absent.
webview2_evergreen_bootstrapper.hash_note: Microsoft re-publishes this bootstrapper under a stable URL, so the hash changes; instead of a hash the installer REQUIRES a valid Authenticode signature from 'Microsoft Corporation' (Get-AuthenticodeSignature) before running it.

vc_redist_x64.role: Microsoft Visual C++ 2015-2022 x64 runtime (needed by the Rust MSVC binary, PyInstaller bundle, rizin MSVC build). Detected only; Doctor prints the download link, nothing is bundled.

rust.note: CI uses the stable channel; the pin records the version the shell was validated with (cargo check on Linux). Windows MSVC builds are unverified until docs/WINDOWS_RELEASE_GATES.md gate W1 passes.

python.note: CI (windows.yml, linux.yml) and the PyInstaller sidecar build use 3.12. The Linux dev host that wrote the controller ran 3.13.16; both are exercised by linux.yml's pytest matrix. 3.11 is the declared floor in controller/pyproject.toml but is not exercised.

sbom_tools.pin_file: scripts/windows/requirements-build.txt (pip-licenses, cyclonedx-bom); cargo-cyclonedx is installed with `cargo install cargo-cyclonedx --version 0.5.9 --locked`

sidecar_build.also_built: rebuild-mcp.exe from scripts/windows/mcp_entry.py (shipped under runtime\Scripts for Install-Clients.ps1)
